content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-44. - Lack of beneficiary.

faqs.a:
Should any member die and not leave a beneficiary entitled to a pension under this
               chapter, such funds as the member shall have paid into the pension fund at the time
               of the member's death shall be paid to such person as the member shall have nominated
               by written designation duly executed and filed with the board. In no event shall such
               refund include any portion of the city's contributions to the pension fund. In default
               of the designation of the beneficiary, all payments made by a member and on the member's
               behalf by the city shall accrue to the pension fund.
(Code 1960, § 19-17(B); Code 1981, § 26-13)
